one_line: Anthropic pursues IPO, Nvidia confronts leadership and export issues, US allies tighten AI chain rules, Alibaba releases model

themes.title: Anthropic plans trillion-dollar IPO
themes.text: Anthropic is targeting up to $90.4 billion in an IPO and private placement, aiming for a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion, while its offering will test its public benefit corporation commitments.

stories.headline: Anthropic targets up to $90.4B in IPO and private placement
Anthropic IPO tests its public benefit commitment

themes.title: Nvidia faces leadership and export scrutiny
themes.text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent demanded answers on Nvidia’s China chip sales and called for a leadership shakeup; Congress is moving to tighten export rules on AI chips after a spy scandal; Nvidia’s board is evaluating successors while interim CEO Colette Kress is expected to rein in deals.

stories.headline: Scott Bessent urges Nvidia leadership shakeup and answers on China chip sales
Congress moves to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
Nvidia considers leadership options after Jensen Huang's departure
Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress expected to rein in deals

themes.title: US allies target AI supply chains
themes.text: The United States, Japan, the United Kingdom and India agreed to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect against China; the Trump administration plans to name more than two dozen AI firms as national champions; Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is pushing to narrow chip curbs affecting Southeast Asian data centers and will travel to China with the president.

stories.headline: US and allies agree to create joint list to protect AI supply chains from China
Trump administration plans to name AI "national champions"
Howard Lutnick pushed to narrow chip curbs affecting a former firm's client
Howard Lutnick joins Trump on Air Force One to China amid Nvidia chip curbs dispute

themes.title: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max model
themes.text: Alibaba released Qwen4‑Max, a 2.4 trillion‑parameter Mixture‑of‑Experts model with a 1‑million‑token context window, and says it outperforms Qwen3.8‑Max while using up to about 50 % fewer tokens.
